title: Module strict-transform presentations on algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to T$ a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Let $\mathcal K$ be a quasi-coherent ideal on $T$ [def-sfb-space-quasi-coherent-ideal], let $p:B\to T$ be a blowup presentation [def-sfb-space-blowup-presentation], and let $P$ be a strict-transform presentation [def-sfb-space-strict-transform-presentation], with ambient fibre product $Y$, projection $q:Y\to X$ and $b:Y\to B$. Let $M$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Using tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], put $H=q^*M$. For every small etale test $V\to Y$, let $J(V)$ be the ideal generated by the image of $(b p)^*\mathcal K\to\mathcal O_Y$ on $V$, as in [def-sfb-space-ideal-power-products]. A module strict-transform presentation consists of an $\mathcal O_Y$-module $N$ and an epimorphism $\pi:H\to N$ whose kernel has the following exact section rule. For $s\in H(V)$, $\pi(s)=0$ if and only if there exists a covering sieve $R$ on $V$ such that, for every $a:W\to V$ in $R$, there is $n\geq0$ such that for every further test $c:Z\to W$ and $r\in J(Z)^n$ one has $r\,s|_Z=0$. The epimorphism and its full kernel determine the quotient up to a unique isomorphism preserving $\pi$. For finite-type $\mathcal K$ and quasi-coherent $M$ [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], this is the quotient by local exceptional power torsion of Stacks Tag 0862(1), hence the module strict transform. The centre $\mathcal K$ remains part of the data.
